rationale: checkoutservice_cpu rose from 0.4289 to 18.2902 (+4164.9%, z=+226.43), by far the largest anomaly in the digest, with secondary memory (+38.5%) and socket (+21.8%) increases consistent with a busy process. No other service shows meaningful metric shifts, and there are no warning or error logs and no error spans, so nothing contradicts a CPU-saturation fault localized at checkoutservice.

proposed_fix.description: Investigate checkoutservice CPU consumption (profile or inspect recent changes), then restart or scale out the checkoutservice replicas and apply CPU limits or autoscaling to relieve saturation.
